title: How a Black Umbrella trial signup flows today
subtitle: From the ad page to GHL and the Operator Base bell. As of 2 Oct 2026.

rows.label: /trial page
rows.detail: A visitor sends the form. The page posts it to Operator Base on the server.

rows.label: Operator Base onboarding API
rows.detail: Makes a pre-filled onboarding session in the Black Umbrella agency.

rows.label: Setup page
rows.detail: The client answers the questions, then submits.

rows.label: Webhook events
rows.detail: A cron job sends them every minute. `created` goes once per session.

rows.label: Bell notices
rows.detail: The agency owner sees "started" and "completed". No push, no email.

rows.label: GHL: Trial Reminders Black Umbrella DFY
rows.detail: Every event enters. The If/Else lets only `created` through. No reminder waits yet.

rows.label: Open gap: Onboarding Submitted URL
rows.detail: On submit, Operator Base calls this URL. No workflow holds the trigger, so a finished onboarding starts nothing in GHL. A stop-reminders path would go here. Your call.

footer: Sources: memory bu-trial-page.md and ob-onboarding-bell-notices.md, worker report bg76 (2 Oct 2026).
